messages.subject: Lunchtime seminar: 'Privilege in internal investigations' - 25 Feb
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Join us for a CPD lunchtime seminar on 25 February, 12:30-13:30 in the Bishopsgate training room: 'Maintaining privilege in corporate internal investigations'. Sandwiches provided. 1 hour CPD. Please RSVP via the intranet.

Knowledge & Learning
